description.text: Grants [Tactical Awoken Mode], [Tactical Awoken Mode: Matoya], [MAG +500 (25s) (Tactical)] to user.

description.name: Tactical Awoken Mode
description.text: Keeps track of TP level (0~6), increases TP level by 1 when the character is hit by a damaging attack or an ally uses a damaging action, casts a certain ability when TP level reaches 6. Removed after 8 abilities.

description.name: Tactical Awoken Mode: Matoya
description.text: Fire/Ice/Lightning abilities deal 30% more damage, have +10,000 damage cap, deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, trigger 2 additional times, have zero hone cost, triggers [111% ATB 1] after using Fire/Ice/Lightning abilities while in Tactical Awoken Mode; removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text: One single piercing attack (31.00) capped at 199,999. Grants [Fire, Ice, Lightning Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)], [Fire, Ice, Lightning 125% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)], [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user, grants [Fire, Ice, Lightning Ability +50% Boost (Tactical)], [Fire, Ice, Lightning 142% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)] to user/[Magical +30% Boost (15s)] to all allies if there are 0-2/3+ Witch allies in the party.
